subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the father, replacing the adult man in the blue shirt in <Video 1>. His appearance comes from <Picture 1>: a large round brown furry creature with a cream muzzle and belly, three dark curved head stalks, big uneven eyes, two small front teeth, short arms and small dark feet.
<Subject 4> is the son, replacing the boy in green in <Video 1>. His appearance comes from <Picture 4>: an olive-green furry creature with a cream belly, heavy curved eyebrows, a large peach-colored nose and rounded bumps along the head and back. Stage him smaller than the father while preserving his reference silhouette and facial design.
<Subject 5> is the aircraft cabin and remaining parachute packs in <Video 1>: curved metal walls, the open doorway on screen left revealing bright clouds, passenger seating on screen right and two dark parachute packs on the floor.
<Video 1> is the uploaded 14-second source segment beginning at 8 seconds of the original video. It supplies the father's and son's positions, physical interaction, camera movement and reaction timing. Its final fraction of a second is a held source frame.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Replace the father and son with <Subject 1> and <Subject 4>. Preserve the quiet physical interaction and the reversal: the father thinks he must sacrifice himself, but the son reveals that the expert took a schoolbag, leaving two parachutes. Target duration: 14 seconds. The pilot and expert have already exited and never reappear.

<Subject 4> (throughout): attribute_transfer - use the green furry identity for the son's source performance, at a smaller overall scale beside the father.
<Subject 5> (throughout): partially_preserved - retain cabin perspective, open door, seat positions and two parachute packs; adapt local contact for round bodies and remove every source text overlay.
<Video 1> (whole timeline): partially_preserved - preserve composition, gestures and emotional progression while replacing human bodies. Replace the late meme-text effect with an unobstructed reaction hold. No source audio asset is defined or directly copied.

detailed_description:
Use the same dimensional furry character rendering, cool aircraft daylight and gently shaking camera as the preceding segment. A reference sheet shows multiple views of a single identity, never multiple copies. The characters keep their reference anatomy, cream bellies, fur colors and facial features. Do not retain human faces, skin, long arms or clothing. The only visible characters are the father and son. Render one continuous cabin view without panels, subtitles, logos or meme text.

[Shot 1] Start from the staging of <Video 1>: <Subject 1>, the round brown father, sits on the right-hand bench beside the smaller olive-green <Subject 4>. The open doorway is on the left, bright clouds pass outside, and two dark parachute packs lie on the floor. One of the father's short arms supports the child at the shoulder. His other paw gently cups the child's cheek by leaning his torso close, without stretching the arm or hiding the child's peach-colored nose. Both characters remain visibly seated with natural body weight.
During approximately 0-3 seconds, <Subject 1> (S1) looks into the child's eyes and says in a warm, low-mid adult male Mandarin voice, strained by fear but tender, <d>[Chinese]儿子你要好好活下去.</d> His delivery is sincere and restrained. After speaking, he keeps his mouth closed and waits, still supporting the child.
During approximately 3-7.5 seconds, <Subject 4> (S2) looks back at the father and says in a clear younger male Mandarin voice, earnest rather than theatrical, <d>[Chinese]爸爸还有两个降落伞. 那个老爷爷背的是我的书包.</d> He briefly directs his eyes toward the two packs on the floor and then toward the open door. The two parachute packs remain separate, unchanged objects; the schoolbag stays absent because the expert has taken it outside. The child does not become the blue or gray character.
During approximately 7.5-10.5 seconds, <Subject 1> goes still as he understands. His eyes move from the child to the open doorway, then he raises his chin slightly and says in the same warm low-mid adult male Mandarin voice, now dry and incredulous, <d>[Chinese]专家就是好学啊.</d> The child follows the father's gaze. The change from fear to disbelief is carried by eye movement, a small brow lift and a delayed head turn, not exaggerated bouncing.
During approximately 10.5-14 seconds, hold the unobstructed reaction. Both characters stay seated on the right and look toward the left doorway. The father maintains gentle contact at the child's shoulder or cheek. Preserve the two packs on the floor and let the cabin's small vibrations continue. Do not recreate the source's final red text, blur transition or duplicated screen effects. No new character enters, nobody else jumps, and no parachute opens inside the cabin. Only the active speaker moves his mouth; listeners remain silent.

overall_soundscape:
Generate steady aircraft engine rumble and wind through the open door, with subtle seat and fur movement. Newly perform the specified Mandarin dialogue; no source audio is directly copied. No narrator, laugh track or additional lines. Let engine and wind continue under the final silent reaction.
